reviews.title: It’s ok
reviews.text: It can do the job if it weren’t for  the annoying pop up advertising the rip-off premium version every single time you open the app. Then, you dismiss it and have a second one pop up 2 seconds after!  I paid a one time purchase price for this app a long time ago, but of course, greed won yet again. People really pay a monthly fee to use this app? Wow
